This '''individual''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[First Order officer|officer]] who served the [[First Order]] during its [[Cold War|conflict]] with the [[Resistance]]. He was stationed in the primary fire control room of the [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]], under the command of [[Colonel]] [[Erich S. Datoo]], at the [[time]] of the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]].<ref name="TFA" />

==Behind the scenes==
This character was portrayed by [[Tom Edden]] in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. His role was confirmed in the movie's credits.
